description.p: LinuxArch is MacArch for Linux: an emulator of the Acorn Archimedes 300 and 400 series, the A540, the A3000, and the A5000, A3010, A3020 and A4000, with the ARM2, ARM3 or ARM250, running RISC OS 2 or 3 from a ROM you own, or ArcLibre, the free RISC OS rebuilt from Acorn's public sources.

ul.li: Floppies (ADFS D, E, F, L, M and S, and protected JFD and HFE originals), with their changes saved back or to a new image
ST506 and IDE hard discs: new, from files, resized, with files added
A minute of rewind, save states, quick saves and screenshots
The keyboard by position or by character, custom keys, and the three-button mouse captured or following the desktop's pointer
Sharp, smooth or CRT display, with the full border, a little of it or none
ROMs found in images, chip sets, folders and ZIP archives

description.p: New hard discs get an empty Library, and a machine with a hard disc starts on it (drive 4), so installers such as Acorn C/C++'s find the library.
New hard discs have !System and !Scrap, as on Acorn's RISC OS 3.1 hard discs; and ArcLibre 0.9.1.
ArcLibre 0.9, the free RISC OS, in its 2 MB form for every model and its 4 MB form for the A5000 family, with its extras disc; and floppy drive sounds.
The first release: MacArch's Archimedes, on Linux.
